Status.note: Status is unchanged. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 59093, generators 10, 11 and 12 (two combustion turbines of 53.1 MW and one steam turbine of 43.2 MW), all operating since June 2017, with no planned retirement. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale announced.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: A Power Engineering article (https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/siemens-to-supply-natural-gas-fired-turbines-for-michigan-power-plant/) says Siemens supplies two SGT-800 gas turbines for the Holland Energy Park. A state air permit staff report from December 2023 (https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/-5736806201363183979) confirms two gas turbines and a steam turbine at the site.

units.notes: The unit is still operating. Latest Activity is left blank because GEM only fills it for units in development or shelved.
